name: Interactive Subscribe
description: Email subscribe card with a draggable cartoon character whose eyes follow the pointer and the typing caret, shows an error pose on invalid email and a confetti success state.
contents: Header with title, subtitle and status badge
Track with draggable character face and eyes
behavior: Character drags horizontally along the track with rubber band edges and inertia
Pupils follow the pointer, or the text caret while the input is focused
Invalid email shows a curved error label and an open mouth
Valid submit shows a success banner and fires confetti, tap the banner to fire again
editableByProps: Accent, character, skin, success and error colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Handle form submission with a real API call

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Card surface colors are dark and hardcoded in the card classes
